Severity and scope are explicit before mitigation spreads

items: Mitigation can reduce impact without proving recovery
SLOs and traces must stay healthy for a fixed window
The final update follows verification, not optimism

items: Stakeholders receive impact, action, and next update time
Rollback remains visible as a deliberate response
Every branch has an owner and observable exit

meta.subtitle: Renderer-driven workflow prototype with lanes, anchored nodes, and orthogonal edges

cards.title: Renderer Rules
items: Lanes and columns determine node placement
Edges attach to explicit node anchors
Cross-lane paths use orthogonal routing
Short adjacent links stay unlabeled

cards.title: Workflow Semantics
items: Approval is a first-class policy step
Consent gates are visible in the main path
External calls stay inside the tool lane
Trace writes are separate from the hot path

cards.title: Why It Matters
items: This is closer to a diagram_type renderer
The graph can be edited without SVG surgery
Layout rules can be tested and improved
A future IR can reuse this shape directly
